source_reconstruction_scope: Renderer-independent actor-owned host composition of existing bounded source kernels and unchanged original AISExternal monster Lua callbacks. This composition is not a full original function body and is not wired to the Android runtime.
composition: Caller supplies an already initialized source TargetList and calls only after source _UpdateAggro selects the normal search branch; selected radius/cone are passed through.

The bridge executes filter-2 target search, Enemy/Friend/Neutral relation classification and candidate consumption, raises event 9 through the recovered AI dispatcher, runs CharAI::OnEnemySpotted and the unchanged monster Lua callback, then routes SetTarget through CharAI::AI_SetTarget and HeadTo through Character controller/PathTo source kernels.
One VM/session is owned per actor. Stable actor and selected-AIS identities are checked before source calls; stale bindings and synchronous rebind/reset fail closed.

Event 0x0c is raised by the candidate consumer with the current +0x40 identity. The existing RaiseAIEvent kernel intentionally maps it to no-argument CharAI vtable +0x48, so the callback receives no payload and reads current actor state itself.
Property ID/value providers pass raw fixed-point values to the existing source Lua FromFixed conversion without pre-scaling.

Result overlap is rejected for directly known borrowed source state. The caller owns disjointness and lifetime for dynamic room links, registry objects, captured faction tables, and all provider backing storage.
